data.name: Hindiyyah
data.gender_notes: Hindiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The beautiful and delicate flower that is Hindiyyah. The name Hindiyyah carries the meaning “A delicate flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hindiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody a delicate flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner beauty and fragility of a person
data.etymology: Hindiyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A delicate flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hindiyyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ھندية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من كلمة هند، تعني المرأة الحميمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ھندية مشتق من كلمة هند، وھي كلمة عربية تعني المرأة الحميمة أو المرأة التي تعيش في الهند، وقد وردت في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية 92، 'وَكَذَلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِن أَشْرَكْتَ يَأْتِيَنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَحْدَهُ'، وفي الحديث النبوي الشريف، 'أَتَانِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلّمَ بِھندٍ فَأَسْلَمَتْ'. يعتبر اسم ھندية من الأسماء ذات الأصول العربية وله دلالة على الحميمية والانتماء.

in_urdu.name: ہندیہ
in_urdu.meaning: مرادف ہے ہند کی رہنے والی یا ہندوستانی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہندیہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں ہند کی رہنے والی یا ہندوستانی۔ یہ نام قرآنی آیات میں نہیں آیا ہے، لیکن حدیث نبوی شریف میں ذکر ہے۔ ہندیہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے مابین مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر ہندوستان اور پاکستان میں۔ اس کا تعلق ہندوستان کی ثقافت اور تاریخ سے ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی روایات کے مطابق ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हिंदिया
in_hindi.meaning: हिंद की रहने वाली या हिंदुस्तानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिंदिया नाम का अर्थ है हिंद की रहने वाली या हिंदुस्तानी। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका संबंध हिंदुस्तान की संस्कृति और इतिहास से है। हिंदिया नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, खासकर भारत और पाकिस्तान में। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं के अनुसार है और इसका आध्यात्मिक महत्व भी है।

in_pashto.name: هندۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: هندۍ نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د هند ښځه یا هندی دی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان په پښتو ژبې ویلو کې کارول کیږي. هندۍ نوم د پښتنو په دودیزو نومونو کې شامل دی او د هندي کلتور او تاریخ سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Hindiyyah
in_english.meaning: One from India or belonging to India
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hindiyyah is derived from the Arabic root 'hind', which refers to India or someone from India. The term 'hindiyyah' specifically means 'one from India' or 'belonging to India'. In Islamic tradition, the name Hindiyyah holds cultural significance and reflects the historical connections between the Arab world and the Indian subcontinent. The name is mentioned in various Islamic texts and is associated with positive qualities such as hospitality and warmth.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Hindiyyah" in the Islamic context is attributed to a delicate and exquisite flower, specifically the Helichrysum italicum, also known as the Immortelle or Everlasting flower. This flower has a deep cultural significance in numerous Muslim communities, particularly in South Asia and the Middle East. The name "Hindiyyah" is often given to girls as a part of their identity, much like how Western cultures may give children names derived from flowers or natural elements. The use of this beautiful and fragrant flower name in the Islamic tradition enhances the symbolic beauty of the Islamic culture and the community's appreciation for nature's splendor.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the Islamic name "Hindiyyah" stems from the meaning of the flower itself. The Helichrysum italicum, as the name suggests, is believed to be everlasting or immortal. In the Islamic faith, this spiritual symbolism can be related to the concept of growing in faith and good deeds, striving towards spiritual immortality in the hereafter. Thus, the name "Hindiyyah" can serve as a reminder for individuals to persist in their spiritual journey towards gaining eternal paradise in Allah's presence. Additionally, the fragrance of the Hindiyyah flower is a reminder of the sweet aroma of righteous actions and good character, which can bring us closer to Allah and His favor.
